exposure: Infants born via vaginal delivery without maternal IAP
Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
Infants born via cesarean section after labor
finding: Cesarean section after labor was associated with reduced infant gut SIgA levels at 3 months, mediated by alterations in gut microbiota and metabolites of microbial or milk origin.
mod_finding: Compared to vaginal birth without IAP, cesarean section after labor was associated with reduced infant gut SIgA levels at 3 months.
